newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic to develop video-on-demand.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic to develop video-on-demand.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp's Video Services division said on Wednesday it has begun to develop its video-on-demand (VOD) product for commercial use.
Bell Atlantic said in a statement it hoped to deploy the interactive service over its Philadelphia switched broad band network in 1998.

The company also said it ended its market trial of the product over copper wires, because the product would be used over fiber optic lines in the future. It had been testing video-on-demand on 1,000 customers since May 1995.

"We have reached...the point of diminishing returns in terms of what we can learn from a VOD field test using copper wires," Stuart Johnson, chairman of Bell Atlantic Video Services, said in a statement.

The company said its new goal was to enhance and upgrade the video-on-demand delivery and support systems, to deploy it over an optical fiber-to-the-curb distribution architecture, or a so-called switched broad band network.
Bell Atlantic said, among other things, it learned promoting techniques from the market trial.
